current_flow: backend-observability adds the app-wide global exception filter (const 07) and structured JSON request/error logging with correlationId (const 05 §2.1) under backend/src/common/, wired in main.ts configureApp so both bootstrap() and the configureApp+app.init tests exercise it. Input: the vendored NestFactory app + configureApp seam + const 05/06/07 + decision 0013 (PoC scope) + D-0010. Output: the filter + a structured logger + a request-logging middleware, shared error/correlation types in the contract, config environment/serviceName, main.ts's 3 console.* migrated, and two hermetic tests registered in the backend allow-list. It closes the handler+logging portion of D-0004; metrics, non-Local transport, and Swagger error DTOs are deferred (D-0018/19/20).
new_abstractions: the global @Catch() exception filter producing the const-07 error envelope
the structured JSON logger (transport seam; console for Local)
the request-logging middleware (ingress correlationId/requestId; request record on finish)
the shared ErrorPayload/ErrorEnvelope/Environment types in the contract

criteria_map.a global exception filter (constitution: KEEP. Global @Catch() filter -> the const-07 envelope (errorId/type/userMessage/sanitized details/statusCode/correlationId/requestId/environment/timestampUtc), wired via useGlobalFilters in configureApp before the swagger early-return; code/type/userMessage/details mapping + sanitization specified (finding 4); module under backend/src/common/ (finding 8).
criteria_map.structured JSON logging (constitution 05: KEEP. Structured JSON request + distinct error records with every required field; correlationId from a valid inbound x-correlation-id else a UUID at ingress, shared across response + both records; request record on response finish so accountId follows AuthGuard (finding 7); console transport for Local with a seam, non-Local transport deferred D-0019 (finding 6); log levels 4xx debug/5xx error, metrics deferred D-0018 (finding 5).
criteria_map.the wiring is proven through configureAp: KEEP. Wiring proven through configureApp()+app.init() by two hermetic tests registered in the backend allow-list (backend/package.json + tools/quality-gate.test.mjs, finding 1); main.ts's 3 console.* migrated (D-0010, finding 2); spec provenance corrected (finding 3); closes the handler+logging portion of D-0004.

gaps: The two new observability tests cannot join CI: the backend hermetic runner keeps an exact explicit test list in backend/package.json and tools/quality-gate.test.mjs, neither in scope
The plan contradicts D-0010, which assigns the three main.ts console.* calls to this task; the plan excluded them
Governing docs claim observability shipped in api-surface-trim (D-0004 done; spec ~154) while the task and source say it does not exist yet - false provenance would remain
The error contract is underspecified: code/type/userMessage/details have no mapping, allowed values, or sanitization rule, risking the leaks the filter must prevent
The plan omits const-07 required behavior: log levels for validation 400s vs 500s, sanitized-stack logging, and error metrics
The stdout-only logger violates the non-Local transport rule (const 05/06 allow console only for Local; other environments require centralized transport)

Traceability is not proved: accountId is null at ingress before AuthGuard; tests do not assert shared correlation/request IDs across response+logs, invalid inbound IDs, a real 500, or non-Local stack non-leakage
Module belongs under common (const 03) not a new top-level observability/; the const also wants a decorated Swagger error DTO and the shipped frontend does not consume the shared types
resolutions: Added backend/package.json + tools/quality-gate.test.mjs to write_scope; both required tests are registered in the hermetic allow-list so verify.py runs them and the quality-gate guard stays green.
This task now migrates main.ts's three console.* emitters (bootstrap/listen/fatal) onto the structured logger per D-0010; the recon/pins/migrate emitters stay deferred (D-0009).
docs/specs/app-platform-base.md (~154) is in write_scope and is corrected to attribute the handler+logging to backend-observability, the reconciliation decision 0013 already mandated.

code (HttpException->status-derived / VALIDATION_ERROR / INTERNAL_ERROR), type, userMessage (safe static), and details (only validation fieldErrors; never provider errors/stacks/PII) are now specified in the plan + reviewer_focus.

Log levels specified (4xx incl. validation at debug/info, 5xx at error) and the sanitized stack goes in the LOG only (response stack only when environment=Local). Error metrics are deferred as D-0018 per the PoC scope (client decision).
Console transport is correct for the Local PoC (const 06); the logger exposes a transport seam. Non-Local centralized transport is deferred as D-0019 (client decision).

The request record is emitted on response finish so accountId follows AuthGuard; the tests now assert shared correlationId/requestId across response+request-log+error-log, an honored valid inbound x-correlation-id, a generated UUID for an absent/invalid one, a real 500, and non-Local stack non-leakage.

Module moved to backend/src/common/ (const 03); shared error TYPES live in the contract and are consumed by the backend filter; the decorated Swagger error DTO is deferred as D-0020/D-0009 (client decision). No claim that the shipped frontend consumes them.

rounds.question: T9 scope: constitution 07/05 full compliance implies error metrics, non-Local centralized log transport, and decorated Swagger error DTOs. Decision 0013's PoC scope only names the handler + structured logging + correlationId. How should T9 handle the extras?

summary: One cold read returned eight blocking handover gaps. Seven are repository-answerable and resolved in the amended plan + contract (test registration, D-0010 console migration, spec provenance fix, error-field mapping+sanitization, log levels, response-finish accountId + strengthened traceability tests, module under common). The one genuine scope decision - whether to build or defer the full-compliance extras (metrics, non-Local transport, Swagger error DTO) - went to the client, who chose PoC scope: defer them as D-0018/19/20. Decision keep, verdict pass.
